title: OPEN: Returning series of 10 short stories
description:
OPEN is an anthology TV series that taps into deep, spontaneous, emotional connections

and the thrilling exploration of sexuality between lovers. Comprised of 10 stand-alone

short stories that range in length from 10 to 30 minutes, OPEN will focus on both the

female and male core impulses of pleasure and desire. Each season of OPEN will take

place in a new city and a new country, giving the audience not only an insight to the

characters before them, but also the cultural fabric of the world that surrounds them.


Available Materials: Proof of Concept Short, Pitch Deck, Series Bible
